parameters.content:
## Extract action items from meeting transcripts and create Notion tasks with AI

### How it works

This workflow receives a meeting transcript through a webhook, extracts meeting metadata, and uses OpenAI to identify action items. It parses the AI response, routes malformed output to a human-review Slack alert, and otherwise logs the meeting in Google Sheets. It then posts a Slack summary, splits extracted action items into individual records, and creates a Notion task for each one.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook URL in the system that submits meeting transcripts, ensuring the payload includes the transcript and any expected meeting metadata.
- Add OpenAI credentials and verify the prompt/configuration in the AI extraction step matches the desired action-item JSON format.
- Connect Slack credentials and set the channels for parse-failure alerts and meeting summaries.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheet/sheet used to log meetings.
- Connect Notion credentials and select the target database for action-item tasks, mapping fields such as title, owner, due date, priority, and source meeting.

### Customization

Adjust the Config and AI prompt nodes to change the extraction schema, required fields, priority rules, or fallback behavior. Update the Slack messages, Google Sheets columns, and Notion database mappings to match your team’s workflow.

## Receive and prepare transcript

Webhook intake and initial code steps that extract meeting details and apply configuration before AI processing. These nodes form the leftmost input/preparation cluster.

## Extract and parse actions

Uses OpenAI to extract structured action items from the transcript, then parses the AI JSON response and flags responses that need review.

## Review routing and logging

Branching cluster that checks whether human review is needed, sends a Slack alert when parsing fails, and logs successfully parsed meeting data to Google Sheets.

## Summarize and create tasks

Posts the meeting summary to Slack, expands the extracted action-item list into separate workflow items, and creates a Notion task for each action item.
